distributor.name: eThekwini Municipality Electricity Unit
distributor.notes: eThekwini uses single flat rates per customer class (no inclining blocks) — 'every resident pays the same rate for electricity' (Electricity Tariff Engineer, July 2026). Official 2026/27 rate tables: final-tariff-tables-2026-2027.pdf on durban.gov.za; tariff tables state energy charges c/kWh VAT-inclusive.

approved_increase.notes: Final 9% adopted in the May 2026 budget, revised down from the 10.5% in the March 2026 draft; implementation from 1 July 2026 confirmed by the Energy Management Directorate.
